name: Savings USDD
oneLiner: sUSDD is the TRON DAO Reserve's savings wrapper of USDD; share price accrues savings yield while final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics.
collateral: USDD deposited into the USDD savings system; sUSDD remains economically backed by USDD while savings yield accrues through the wrapper exchange rate
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDD to receive sUSDD, whose value appreciates versus USDD as savings yield accrues; final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics

proofOfReserves.provider: TRON DAO Reserve USDD data dashboard (client-rendered live collateral-ratio page)

deployedExposure.basis: Exact immutable SavingsUsdd source identifies the non-idle position as a USDD savings claim recorded through UsddJoin and Pot: _mint transfers USDD, calls Join.join and Pot.join, while withdrawals reverse those accounting operations. Zero idle USDD does not establish a direct Smart Allocator or external lending allocation. Source correction reviewed 2026-10-20; original attestation start and historical balance pin are retained.
